name: Silver trapping and detrapping in SiC
status_basis: Newly proposed mechanism. Literature and candidate equations are collected in the entry; STRATO has no derivation, register row, code or test for it.
required_parameters: trap site density for Ag in SiC (missing);trap energy for Ag in SiC (missing; only an atomistic surface-desorption range in xiao2012);trapping rate coefficient (missing);SiC lattice atom density (missing);mobile Ag diffusivity in SiC (registered: data/diffusivity/arrhenius.csv#A3-05, effective);Ag-110m decay constant (registered: data/nuclear/decay.csv Ag-110m);SiC porosity, pore size and grain size for the effective form (missing)
missing_work: No measured or computed trap density or trap energy for Ag in AGR-1 SiC was found. Needs atomistic trap energies at pores and triple junctions, a derivation of the coupled system on the spherical finite-volume mesh with conservation and limiting-case checks, and comparison with AGR-1 Ag-110m retention after Phase 2.2.

name: Silver grain-boundary transport in polycrystalline SiC
status_basis: Newly proposed mechanism. Literature and candidate equations are collected in the entry; STRATO has no derivation, register row, code or test for it.
required_parameters: grain minor-axis length of AGR-1 SiC per variant (missing; reported in gerczak2016 and compiled in simon2022);fit coefficients Dm0 Dm1 Qm0 Qm1 (missing; printed in simon2022);correction factor delta_corr (missing; 8.5 in simon2022, 10 in parsons2024);lattice and grain-boundary Ag diffusivities per boundary type (missing; atomistic values in khalil2011, ko2016, rabone2015);segregation factor and boundary width (missing);empirical effective Ag diffusivity in SiC (registered: data/diffusivity/arrhenius.csv#A3-05)
missing_work: Microstructure data not registered; the mesoscale model was compared with AGR-1 after selecting a grain size per compact; boundary-type-resolved diffusivities and an independent delta_corr are missing; irradiation and Pd effects are not in the base model. Rides on Phase 2.2 (temperature-dependent diffusivity); per-temperature comparison with public data only after that.

name: Palladium-assisted degradation of SiC (Pd-SiC interaction)
status_basis: Newly proposed mechanism. Literature and candidate equations are collected in the entry; STRATO has no derivation, register row, code or test for it.
required_parameters: Pd penetration-rate coefficients (missing; printed in miller2018);SiC thickness (registered: data/geometry/geometry.csv#G-04);particle temperature history (missing for this use);Pd inventory and arrival at the IPyC-SiC interface (missing);failed-layer diffusivity (missing; arbitrary value in miller2018);local attack at IPyC cracks (missing)
missing_work: No Pd nuclide or fission yield is registered; the penetration correlation is global and temperature-only while AGR-1 failures were local; atomistic Pd-SiC calculations and a derivation of the layer-state switch with conservation checks are missing.
